scope: Current-source review of incomplete request-head EOF handling: 69 existing HTTP/router/header-limit regressions, 12 targeted TCP write-half-close cases and one recovery request. Original pool(1,1) and 30-second socket options are retained. No real receive/send timeout, concurrency or full-stage acceptance in this run.
temporary_source_change: Only a temporary tcp_server.cpp copy changes 8080 to a kernel-allocated loopback port; all repository C++ and CMake files remain unchanged.
